title: Inference-Time Scaling of Verification: Self-Evolving Deep Research Agents via Test-Time Rubric-Guided Verification
authors_zh: Yuxuan Wan、Tianqing Fang、Zaitang Li、Yintong Huo、Wenxuan Wang、Haitao Mi、Dong Yu、Michael R. Lyu（机构：香港中文大学、腾讯 AI Lab、新加坡管理大学、中国人民大学）
paper_type_zh: 智能体验证与测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 构建需要把额外推理计算投入循证自我纠错的联网智能体的读者。
one_line: DeepVerifier converts agent failure rubrics into targeted test-time checks and feedback loops that improve deep-research-agent answers through repeated verification and retry.
DeepVerifier 将智能体失败量表转为有针对性的测试时检查与反馈循环，通过反复验证和重试提升深度研究智能体的答案。
why: It operationalizes verification as a repeatable inference loop rather than a final judge call, making extra agent compute target diagnosed failure points.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly scales test-time verification and feedback rounds for deep-research agents, measuring how additional verifier-guided retry compute improves final task success.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Deep-research agents can browse, call tools, write code, and synthesize long reports, but a plausible final response may rest on a missed source, an invalid action, or an unsupported inference buried in a long trajectory. A single final-answer judge is often too coarse: asking another model to re-solve the full task can be as hard as the original task, and a generic critique may not explain what should be checked or how the agent should retry. Human monitoring is also unrealistic when an agent has taken dozens of actions across many pages.

This paper asks whether extra test-time computation can be spent on verification itself rather than only on producing more candidate answers. It formulates a loop that detects likely failure points, turns them into narrower evidence questions, verifies those questions, and feeds targeted advice back to the original agent. The central premise is that checking a localized claim can be easier than generating the entire research result, provided the verifier knows which risky claims deserve the additional work.

深度研究智能体能够浏览网页、调用工具、编写代码并综合长篇报告，但一个看似可信的最终回答可能建立在遗漏来源、无效动作或隐藏在长轨迹中的无依据推断上。单次最终答案评审通常过于粗糙：要求另一模型重新完成整个任务，难度可能与原任务一样高；通用批评也未必说明应检查什么、智能体又该如何重试。当智能体已跨越许多页面采取数十个动作时，人工监控同样不现实。

论文探讨能否把额外的测试时计算花在验证本身，而不是只生成更多候选答案。它构造一个循环：定位可能的失败点，将其转为更窄的证据问题，验证这些问题，并把有针对性的建议反馈给原智能体。核心前提是，只要验证器知道哪些高风险主张值得额外工作，检查局部主张就可能比生成完整研究结论更容易。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DeepVerifier uses a failure taxonomy to make reflection concrete. Instead of issuing an undifferentiated verdict over a full research trace, it summarizes the trace, identifies behaviors associated with known failure categories, and asks high-leverage follow-up questions such as whether a cited source actually supports a claim. The verifier then gathers evidence for those questions and judges the answer using a rubric. A rejection produces instructions for the original agent to repair the response rather than merely a scalar score.

The paper treats each feedback-and-retry round as a test-time scaling unit. More rounds purchase more opportunity to discover and correct failures, but only if the verifier's feedback is accurate enough to guide a productive retry. This shifts the allocation target from parallel answer diversity to iterative verification quality. The same framework also creates verified reflection trajectories that can later be used to train an open verifier, while the paper's central evaluation remains the inference-time loop without additional policy training.

DeepVerifier 使用失败分类体系使反思变得具体。它不对完整研究轨迹给出无差别判决，而是先总结轨迹，识别与已知失败类别相关的行为，再提出高价值追问，例如某个被引用来源是否真的支持某项主张。验证器随后为这些问题搜集证据，并依据量表判断回答。一旦拒绝，系统会给原智能体提供修复回答的指令，而不只是给出一个标量分数。

论文把每一轮“反馈—重试”视为一个测试时扩展单元。更多轮次带来更多发现并修正失败的机会，但前提是验证器的反馈足够准确，能引导有效重试。这把分配目标从并行答案多样性转向迭代验证质量。同一框架还会生成经验证的反思轨迹，后续可用于训练开放验证器；但论文的核心评测仍是无需额外策略训练的推理时循环。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method has three modules. A decomposition agent condenses a long, step-indexed trajectory into the sources visited and the concrete facts retrieved, then matches suspicious behaviors to a taxonomy containing five major failure classes and thirteen subclasses. It produces localized potential errors and follow-up questions. A verification agent sequentially answers those questions with browsing, screenshots, and code execution. Finally, a judge sees the summary, suspected errors, questions, and gathered evidence, explains its decision, and assigns a score from one to four.

At test time, scores at most two mean the response is treated as incorrect, while scores at least three accept it. On rejection, the judge gives actionable retry guidance and may supply an answer when prior evidence already resolves the issue; the loop stops on acceptance or at a fixed retry limit. The taxonomy was built from 2,997 actions over 90 WebAggregatorQA tasks and 555 reconciled error points. For the optional DeepVerifier-4K training resource, the authors collect 400 agent trajectories, retain correctly accepting and correctly rejecting verification traces, balance them, and produce 4,646 prompt-response pairs.

方法包含三个模块。分解智能体先把很长、带步骤索引的轨迹压缩为已访问来源与检索到的具体事实，再将可疑行为匹配到含五个主要失败类和十三个子类的分类体系中。它产出局部潜在错误和追问。验证智能体通过浏览、截图和代码执行，按顺序回答这些问题。最后，评审器看到摘要、可疑错误、问题和已搜集证据，解释其决定，并给出一到四分的评分。

在测试时，至多两分表示回答被视为错误，至少三分则接受回答。若被拒绝，评审器会给出可执行的重试建议；当既有证据已能解决问题时，还可能提供答案。循环在接受或达到固定重试上限时停止。分类体系来自 90 个 WebAggregatorQA 任务中的 2,997 个动作和 555 个经协调的错误点。对于可选的 DeepVerifier-4K 训练资源，作者收集 400 条智能体轨迹，保留正确接受与正确拒绝的验证轨迹并做平衡，最终得到 4,646 个提示—回答对。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On GAIA-Web, DeepVerifier achieves 73.17 F1 for rejecting incorrect answers. The paper reports that it exceeds a vanilla agent-as-judge and an LLM-judge baseline by 12% to 48% in meta-evaluation F1. It evaluates generalization on full GAIA, XBench-DeepSearch, and BrowseComp after using WebAggregatorQA only for taxonomy construction, which is intended to separate the observed failure taxonomy from the final task distributions. The experimental setup includes Claude-3.7-Sonnet, GPT-4.1, and Qwen3-8B backbones.

For the test-time scaling claim, the full GAIA development curve reports increasing performance over zero through ten feedback rounds. The paper states 8% to 11% accuracy gains on challenging GAIA subsets when DeepVerifier is paired with capable closed-source models and 3% to 6% gains on XBench-DeepSearch. It also reports that a DeepVerifier-8B model fine-tuned with the released 4,646-pair resource improves open-model reflection after ten verification and feedback rounds. These results support the more limited conclusion that structured verification feedback can make additional retry compute productive in the evaluated deep-research settings.

在 GAIA-Web 上，DeepVerifier 对错误回答的拒绝 F1 达到 73.17。论文报告，它在元评测 F1 上比朴素智能体评审器和语言模型评审器基线高 12% 到 48%。作者只用 WebAggregatorQA 构建失败分类体系，随后在完整 GAIA、XBench-DeepSearch 和 BrowseComp 上评估泛化，意在把观察到的失败分类与最终任务分布分开。实验设置包含 Claude-3.7-Sonnet、GPT-4.1 和 Qwen3-8B 等骨干模型。

对于测试时扩展主张，完整 GAIA 开发集曲线报告了从零到十轮反馈的性能变化。论文指出，当 DeepVerifier 与能力较强的闭源模型结合时，在有挑战性的 GAIA 子集上有 8% 到 11% 的准确率提升，在 XBench-DeepSearch 上有 3% 到 6% 的提升。它还报告，用发布的 4,646 对资源微调的 DeepVerifier-8B 在十轮验证与反馈后改善了开放模型的反思能力。这些结果支持一个更有限的结论：在所评测的深度研究场景中，结构化验证反馈能够让额外重试计算产生效果。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The central novelty is to scale the act of verification, not just the number of agent rollouts. The paper combines an automatically constructed failure taxonomy with verification asymmetry: it converts a difficult whole-trajectory judgment into smaller claims that can be supported or refuted by targeted evidence. This creates a bridge between a verifier's judgment and an agent's next action, because each rejection identifies a failure type and asks for a concrete correction rather than treating the score as an opaque reranking signal.

It also integrates several levels of use around one verifier. The immediate use is a plug-in test-time module for diagnosis, evidence retrieval, feedback, and retry. A second use is creating filtered reflection supervision for an open model. That distinction matters: the paper does not claim that the data alone causes the primary gains; it shows that the non-training verification loop itself improves closed and open backbones, then offers the dataset as a way to transfer part of the capability into a smaller model.

其核心新意是扩展验证这一行为，而不只是增加智能体轨迹数量。论文将自动构建的失败分类体系与验证不对称性结合：它把困难的整条轨迹判断转化为更小的主张，这些主张可以被有针对性的证据支持或反驳。这样就在验证器判断与智能体下一步动作之间建立桥梁，因为每次拒绝都指出一种失败类型并要求具体纠正，而不是把分数当作不透明的重排序信号。

它还围绕同一个验证器整合了多层使用方式。直接用途是作为插件式测试时模块，用于诊断、证据检索、反馈和重试。第二种用途是为开放模型创建经过过滤的反思监督。这个区分很重要：论文并不声称单靠数据就造成主要增益；它展示非训练的验证循环本身能够改善闭源和开放骨干模型，随后再将数据作为向更小模型迁移部分能力的方式。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The system is expensive, dependent on its verifier backbone, and exposed to the same volatile web environment that the research agent must navigate. A flawed taxonomy can focus additional compute on the wrong issues, a verifier can hallucinate evidence or misjudge a valid answer, and repeated retries can compound cost or create new errors. The reported gains rely partly on capable closed-source models and selected agent benchmarks, so they do not establish a universal scaling law. The separate training resource is curated from a relatively small set of source trajectories and should not be treated as a comprehensive distribution of deep-research failures.
系统成本较高，依赖验证器骨干模型，并且暴露在研究智能体同样必须面对的易变网络环境中。有缺陷的分类体系会把额外计算集中到错误问题上，验证器可能编造证据或误判有效答案，重复重试也可能累积成本或引入新错误。报告的增益部分依赖能力较强的闭源模型和特定智能体基准，因此不能建立普适的扩展定律。独立训练资源来自相对少量的源轨迹，不应被视为深度研究失败的完整分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a web or tool-using agent needs a bounded self-correction loop rather than a single final judge. Its operational template is to log compact trace evidence, classify potential failures, turn only high-risk claims into checkable questions, and attach every rejection to an actionable retry instruction. For a production system, keep separate budgets for original execution, evidence verification, and retries; report acceptance accuracy and final task success together so a stricter verifier is not mistaken for a better agent.
当联网或工具使用智能体需要有界的自我纠错循环，而不是一次最终评审时，可参考这项工作。其运行模板是记录紧凑的轨迹证据，分类潜在失败，只把高风险主张转为可检查问题，并把每次拒绝附加到可执行的重试指令上。对于生产系统，应分别为原始执行、证据验证和重试设定预算；同时报告接受准确性和最终任务成功率，以免把更严格的验证器误认为更好的智能体。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the work as an agent-specific form of sequential test-time scaling. The scarce resource is not only output tokens but also evidence-gathering and verification rounds, and the paper's contribution is a policy for directing those rounds to suspected failures. Distinguish its two artifacts carefully: the GitHub implementation supports the inference loop, while DeepVerifier-4K is a downstream supervised resource derived from filtered verification traces. When comparing this card with repeated-sampling papers, ask whether extra compute is used to generate alternatives, select alternatives, or repair one evolving trajectory; DeepVerifier principally belongs to the third case.

应把这项工作看作面向智能体的序列式测试时扩展。稀缺资源不仅是输出词元，还包括证据搜集与验证轮次；论文的贡献是把这些轮次定向给可疑失败点的策略。应仔细区分两类产物：GitHub 实现支撑推理循环，而 DeepVerifier-4K 是从过滤过的验证轨迹派生出的下游监督资源。与重复采样论文比较时，要问额外计算是用于生成备选、选择备选，还是修复一条不断演化的轨迹；DeepVerifier 主要属于第三种情形。
